facts.text: Snow left North Fork (3,070 ft) 27 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: North Fork
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: June 7 (2023), May 16 (2024), April 26 (2025)

facts.text: At North Fork (3,070 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 2.3 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: North Fork
evidence.detail: 2.3 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 45.5 in (2023), 20.0 in (2024), 11.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 11 and May 3, carried from the melt-out date at North Fork (3,070 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: North Fork
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 716 ft above the pass; points to March 11 to May 3
